sources.population: Healthy FHS sample: no prevalent diabetes/CVD, dyslipidemia, hypertension, abdominal obesity or smoking; 2140 individuals, 3116 repeated observations. Cross-sectional sample is 565 Offspring exam-5 attendees.
sources.measurement: Overnight fasting plasma insulin in pmol/L; assays vary across examination cycles; main model log-transforms insulin then standardizes within exam. Exact assay list is in an unretrieved supplement. Glucose mg/dL; BMI kg/m2. Main article Table 1 gives median (Q1,Q3).

sources.population: Guishan township, Taiwan residents aged 50-90, community health examination in 2014; n=321 (111 men,210 women) after excluding prior diabetes, glucose-lowering drugs/insulin or fasting glucose >=126 mg/dL.
sources.measurement: Ten-hour overnight fast. Serum insulin ARCHITECT Abbott chemiluminescent microparticle immunoassay, microU/mL; intra/interassay variation <2.7%, sensitivity <=1.0 microU/mL. Glucose mg/dL. Tables 1-2 use raw insulin.

sources.population: MACAD Los Angeles Mexican-American family study; 470 offspring-generation adults from 128 families (adult offspring of CAD probands and spouses), 197 men/273 women; no diabetes or clinically manifested CVD by design.
sources.measurement: Twelve-hour fast; insulin averaged from four measurements within 30 minutes before euglycemic clamp; LINCO Human Insulin Specific RIA, microIU/mL (<0.2% proinsulin cross-reactivity). BMI and insulin log-transformed for analyses; M, SI, MCRI square-root transformed.

sources.population: Independent DASA laboratory database, Rio de Janeiro, 2019, ages 20-60; 21684 selected healthy individuals, 18576 women/3108 men; not PNS. Excludes BMI outside [18.5,25), glucose >=100, HbA1c >=5.7%, adverse lipid criteria, specified diabetes/lipid/BP drugs, >2 annual exams; outlier removal/truncation.
sources.measurement: At least 8-hour fast; Roche ECLIA Cobas e-411 serum insulin; intra/interassay CV 1.2%/3.5%. Reference limits are central 95% of processed/truncated distribution with 90% confidence intervals.
